newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - K.C. Southern view repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - K.C. Southern view repeated.

text.p: --Gruntal & Co Inc said on Monday it reiterated an outperform rating on Kansas City Southern Industries Inc

--"We remain buyers because the shares remain undervalued relative to assets owned," Gruntal said in a report, noting that weather battered much of the railroad industry during the Q1 but the company's Kansas City Railway was generally spared.

--It said some unit coal business was lost because of three utility outages. As a result, Gruntal said it will be harder for the company to meet Gruntal's Q1 earnings per share estimate of $0.70 per share. Earnings may fall "somewhere in the upper end of a $0.70 to $0.65 range."
